soil_facts.editorial_note: Five distinct actionable problems selected from original soil-pest advice, existing forcing guidance and current RHS chicory problems. Measurement instructions use established metric/imperial pairs. Wider-row and deep-bed variants retained in notes rather than silently discarded.

soil_facts.editorial_note: All four distinct inline conditions retained; shared differently named mirrors are not separate pest rows. Three source varieties/types retained. Approved module/direct captions retained; complete notes keep June/July follow-crop route and protected/variety qualification for earlier sowing. Old perennial/climate statement and smaller legacy harvest-size rule are omitted as unhelpful generalisations, retained in master.

soil_facts.editorial_note: All five distinct inline problems retained with full organic replacements for slug pellets and permethrin/heptenophos aphid prescriptions. Curly and broad-leaved seasonal uses remain; soil/care retain moisture, shade, thinning and blanching only dry plants. Harvest preserves prompt pale-heart cutting, optional leaf picking and frost-free whole-plant storage. Notes cover successive late sowings plus closer small-leaf spacing with paired units. Full source retained aside from authorised control replacements.
